notes.note: Extractor labels in 0729 are shifted one row late. Per 0729.bla: #0.91 = Seravee's Voice (Seravee holding the base), #0.122 = Ankh, #0.123 = Seravee's Voice. 'Erosion' follows the earlier 'erosion of Veda' rendering.

#0.92-#0.106 and #0.107-#0.121 are 15-row party-leader variant blocks (the 'Seravee's Voice'/'00'/'?party' labels inside them are shifted mislabels). 0729 second-scene Pt_Chara_Check order: Rider 1, Ultraman, Nu, Black RX, Seven, Zeta, Den-O, Taro, God, W, Mebius, Wing Zero, OOO, Zero, 00 (confirmed by #0.113 rough = Momotaros, #0.116 = Shotaro, #0.120 = Zero).

Only polite variant in the block. By the scene-2 order this slot is Seven; the scene-1 order would make it Mebius, which fits the politeness better. Either way it is rendered as the more formal 'What did you say...!?'; the rest stay identical.
Subject of 'have to defeat' restored as 'we' (the party). 'Belial and Dinosaur Greeed' = the two being located via the Memory Memory.
'Memory Memory' in quotes as in story_146. Seravee (Tieria) kept cool and clipped.

0731 labels are correct. Pairs #0.3-#0.32 and #0.37-#0.66 follow Pt_Chara_Check order Zero, OOO, Mebius, W, Taro, Den-O, Seven, Black RX, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00 (confirmed: #0.14 and #0.47-48 rough = Momotaros, #0.37-38 = Zero, #0.43-44 = Shotaro).
'Too' keeps the source's mo: they are finished like the monsters already beaten. 'You' is plural (Belial and Dinosaur Greeed).
Dinosaur Greeed (Dr. Maki), polite: the heroes are ideal material for the final stage of the plan. 'As well' keeps the mo.

Each pair is one sentence split across two rows: '...you're the ones who'll be buried / along with your ambitions!!'. Word choice per variant follows the source (buried vs defeated, sono-itsu vs sore).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0729.bla and 0731.bla: 0729 labels shifted one row late (#0.91/#0.123 are Seravee's Voice, #0.122 is Ankh; in-block labels are mislabels); 0731 labels correct. Uncertain: #0.96 polite variant attributed to Seven or Mebius depending on which Pt_Chara_Check chain applies. No new names or terms.
